It is only after he faces and conquers this internal conflict that he becomes strong enough to take on Hans (his external conflict) and rescue Holly and the other hostages. Without the external conflict from Hans' Plan, McClane would not have been forced to resolve this problem, and their marriage would have ended. The resolution for the external conflict and internal conflict intersect, creating a strong, organic plot.

只有当他直面并克服了内心的冲突之后，他才有足够的力量去对抗汉斯（他的外部冲突），并救出霍莉和其他人质。如果没有汉斯计划带来的外部冲突，麦克莱恩就不会被迫解决这个问题，他们的婚姻也会就此结束。外部冲突和内心冲突的解决相互交织，构成了一个紧凑而自然的剧情。


#↩

THEME

主题

The theme of "Die Hard" is probably dealing with greed and need and love. McClane starts out wanting to drag Holly and the kids back to New York City kicking and screaming, but learns he would risk his life for the love of his wife. Many other characters echo the green and need and love theme throughout the script and find themselves risking their lives for the things they love.

《虎胆龙威》的主题或许在于贪婪、需求和爱。麦克莱恩一开始想把霍莉和孩子们强行拖回纽约，但他最终意识到，为了妻子，他愿意付出生命。剧本中许多其他角色也呼应了贪婪、需求和爱的主题，最终都为了自己所爱之人甘愿冒生命危险。


Holly has a love of self reliance and independence so strong that she risks her life by standing up to the terrorists, as in the scene on page 54-I and 54-J where Holly confronts Hans, slyly calling him an idiot and stating that "Personally, I don't enjoy being this close to you," in order to get medical help and bathroom privileges for the other hostages.

霍莉非常热爱自立自强，甚至不惜冒着生命危险与恐怖分子对抗，例如在第 54-I 和 54-J 页的场景中，霍莉与汉斯对峙，狡猾地称他为白痴，并说“就我个人而言，我不喜欢和你靠得这么近”，以便为其他人质争取医疗救助和上厕所的权利。


Ellis loves to make deals, which is referred to when his character is introduced on page 12, and on page 67 where he attempts to deal with the terrorists. His love for deal making leads to his death, when the deal sours.

埃利斯酷爱做交易，这一点在第12页人物登场时就有所提及，在第67页他试图与恐怖分子谈判时也再次出现。然而，正是他对交易的痴迷最终导致了他的死亡，因为交易最终失败了。


The terrorist Karl loves his brother Tony. When Tony is killed by McClane, Karl vows vengeance. From this point on, Karl's sole motivation is revenge against McClane for his brother's death. He is no longer an active participant in Hans' Plan, except when it intersects his own goals.

恐怖分子卡尔深爱着他的弟弟托尼。托尼被麦克莱恩杀死后，卡尔发誓要复仇。从那时起，卡尔唯一的动力就是为弟弟报仇，向麦克莱恩复仇。他不再积极参与汉斯的计划，除非该计划与他自身的目标相冲突。

The reporter Thornburg loves breaking stories. When he first hears of the Nakatomi Tower takeover, he dumps his girlfriend to cover the story (page 53). Even after getting punched in the nose, Thornburg's response is "Did you get that?" to the camera man. Story before self.

记者索恩伯格酷爱独家新闻。当他第一次听说中富大厦被收购的消息时，他为了报道此事，甚至甩了女友（第53页）。即使被人打了一拳，索恩伯格对摄影师的第一反应仍然是：“你拍到了吗？” 他把新闻放在了个人利益之上。


Deputy Chief Dwayne T. Robinson loves to be officious. He would risk the lives of the hostages just for the chance of adding a little red tape to the negotiations.

副警长德韦恩·T·罗宾逊喜欢装腔作势。为了给谈判增加一点繁文缛节，他甚至不惜拿人质的生命冒险。


Even a minor Terrorist's love for junk food takes him to the extreme of snagging a candy bar

即使是小恐怖分子，对垃圾食品的喜爱也让他极端到会去偷一块巧克力棒。

during a shoot out scene... but that may be greed and need as well.

在枪战场景中……但那也可能是贪婪和需求的表现。


Hans, of course, loves material possessions. He could discuss men's fashions all day, but they are here to rob the vault of 640 million dollars. After the robbery has soured and Hans has been tossed out a broken window, what does he grab hold of? Holly's gold Rolex. He's still grabbing at possessions, even on his way down to the pavement.

汉斯当然喜欢物质享受。他可以整天谈论男装，但他们此行的目的是抢劫价值6.4亿美元的金库。抢劫失败后，汉斯被从破窗扔了出去，他抓起什么？霍莉的金劳力士手表。即使在摔到人行道上，他仍然在抓着自己的财物。


#↩

VILLAIN'S SUPERIORITY

反派的优势

Before he reaches the pavement, Hans Gruber has shown himself to be superior in every way. Not only is his plan well thought out and ingenious, he is actually several moves ahead of everyone else. He knows the FBI will cut the power, and has planned ahead. He has a plan for every move McClane makes, from setting the fire alarms to radioing the police. His plan to open the vault at Nakatomi is complex and flawless. Hans' forethought, his "exactness and attention to every detail" has supplied a solution for every conceivable problem.

在汉斯·格鲁伯落地之前，他已经展现出各方面都远胜于麦克莱恩的实力。他的计划不仅周密巧妙，而且实际上比所有人都领先好几步。他知道联邦调查局会切断电源，并已提前做好了准备。从设置火警警报到通知警方，他为麦克莱恩的每一个举动都制定了计划。他打开中富金库的计划复杂而完美。汉斯的先见之明，以及他对“每一个细节的精准和关注”，为所有可能出现的问题都提供了解决方案。


And Hans is clever enough to think on his feet. When McClane stumbles upon him on the top floor of the building, here's what happens:

汉斯非常聪明，能够随机应变。当麦克莱恩在大楼顶层偶然发现他时，发生了以下事情：


***


Hans turns, looks up.

汉斯转过身，抬头望去。

The transformation in his expression and bearing are mind-

他表情和举止的变化令人心动。

boggling. Hands shaking, eyes filled with fear, he swallows,

难以置信。他双手颤抖，眼中充满恐惧，他咽了口唾沫。

looks up at McClane and in a perfect American accent says:

他抬头看着麦克莱恩，用一口地道的美国口音说道：


HANS

汉斯

...OhGodplease...don'tkill me...don't kill

哦，上帝啊……求求你……别杀我……别杀我

me... you're one of them, I know it...

我……你也是其中之一，我知道……


McCLANE

麦克莱恩

Whoa, easy man. I won't hurt you.

哇，冷静点，我不会伤害你的。


***


This scene turns into a multi-reversal. Hans talks McClane into giving him a gun. Hans then reveals his identity and aims the gun at McClane. But McClane has removed the clip, making the gun useless. But Hans has alerted Karl and Franco, who attack McClane. Which leads to the glass shooting sequence, where Hans proves his strategic superiority, and presses McClane to his point of no return which leads into the third act.

这一幕反转不断。汉斯说服麦克莱恩给他一把枪。随后，汉斯暴露身份，用枪指着麦克莱恩。但麦克莱恩已经卸下了弹匣，枪无法使用。汉斯同时通知了卡尔和弗兰科，两人随即攻击麦克莱恩。接下来便是玻璃碎片射击的场景，汉斯在此展现了他的战略优势，将麦克莱恩逼到了绝境，由此引出了第三幕。


This is the first time that McClane and Hans come face to face, and it happens fairly late in the script (page 78). The relationship between hero and villain in "Die Hard" doesn't follow the "Flipside" model traditionally used in action films, where the hero and villain's similarities are accentuated. Instead, "Die Hard" harkens back to the social consciousness films of the 1930s, like Warner Brother's "Captain Blood", where the differences between hero and villain are highlighted... which again may play into the need and greed and love.

这是麦克莱恩和汉斯第一次正面交锋，而且这一幕发生在剧本的后半部分（第78页）。《虎胆龙威》中英雄与反派的关系并没有遵循动作片中常见的“正反派”模式——即强调英雄与反派的相似之处。相反，《虎胆龙威》更像是上世纪30年代具有社会意识的电影，例如华纳兄弟的《铁血船长》，这类电影着重展现英雄与反派之间的差异……而这或许也与人们的欲望、贪婪和爱有关。


McClane and Hans are almost opposites. McClane with his working class, blue collar back ground; and Hans with his classical education and Saville Row suits. This is a battle of style and substance, with McClane's street experience pitted against what Hans read about in Time Magazine or Forbes and saw on 60 Minutes (pg 24, 68, 74). McClane and Hans' first conversation (pg 54-A) points out the contrasts between the two. Hans' dialogue is refined, he refers to McClane as a 'party crasher'. McClane, on the other hand, makes references to game shows and cowboys, calling himself "Just the fly in the ointment, the monkey in the wrench, the pain in the ass".

麦克莱恩和汉斯几乎是截然相反的两个人。麦克莱恩出身工人阶级，蓝领背景；而汉斯则接受过古典教育，身着萨维尔街定制西装。这是一场风格与内涵的较量，麦克莱恩的街头经验与汉斯从《时代》杂志或《福布斯》杂志上读到的、以及在《60分钟》节目中看到的形象形成了鲜明的对比（第24、68、74页）。麦克莱恩和汉斯的第一次对话（第54-A页）就凸显了两人之间的差异。汉斯的言辞文雅，他称麦克莱恩为“不速之客”。而麦克莱恩则经常提及游戏节目和牛仔，自嘲为“美中不足、碍事、令人讨厌的人”。


One of the keys to the success of "Die Hard" is John McClane himself. He speaks in a language we can understand, rather than the stuffy, dry, pseudo intellectual and professorial language of Hans. He IS a cowboy: an individualistic man whose character is earthy and grounded in reality. A multi layered hero, who isn't afraid to admit to his fear. In his introduction (pg 1), we see him white knuckled as the 747 lands in Los Angeles. When a fellow passenger comments on his fear of flying, McClane makes a joke about it at his own expense. He is a man who acknowledges his fears and weaknesses and has learned to live with them.

《虎胆龙威》成功的关键之一在于约翰·麦克莱恩这个角色本身。他说话的方式通俗易懂，不像汉斯那样故作高深、枯燥乏味，充满伪知识分子和教授的腔调。他就是牛仔：一个个性鲜明、性格朴实、脚踏实地的人。他是一个多面英雄，从不畏惧承认自己的恐惧。在影片开头（第1页），我们看到他紧握双拳，飞机747降落在洛杉矶。当一位同机乘客谈及他的恐飞症时，麦克莱恩拿自己开起了玩笑。他是一个正视自己的恐惧和弱点，并学会与之共存的人。


When McClane is faced with dangerous situations later on, this fear humanizes him. He is not some super human hero; but a husband, father, and very mortal man who must overcome his fears to survive. He feels as we would in his situation. McClane must grow into a hero to survive. That growth is the key to a successful action script, as witnessed by both "The Fugitive" and "In The Line Of Fire" which follow the same pattern.

当麦克莱恩后来面临危险境地时，这种恐惧反而让他更有人情味。他并非超人英雄，而是一位丈夫、一位父亲，一个必须克服恐惧才能生存的普通人。他感同身受，就像我们身处他的境地一样。麦克莱恩必须成长为一名真正的英雄才能生存下去。这种成长是成功动作剧本的关键，《亡命天涯》和《火线狙击》都遵循着同样的模式。


#↩

CONCLUSIONS

结论


One of the most impressive aspect's of Steven deSouza's writing in "Die Hard" is the ending, where a dozen sub plots are brought to conclusion in 4 quick pages. From Hans' death, to the Nakatomi Bonds falling like Christmas snow, to Holly giving up her gold Rolex (and all the greed is symbolizes), to Argyle the limo driver's smashing the getaway car in the underground garage, to the first face-to-face meeting of hero and sidekick (McClane and Powell), to Thornburg getting punched in the nose (for being too nosey), to Dpt. Chief Robinson's officiousness being completely ignored, to Karl's last ditch revenge for his brother's death, to Sgt. Powell regaining his ability to shoot his gun, to Holly and McClane reuniting... All of this and more in the space of four flowing pages. DeSouza makes this complex web seem effortless and elegant.

史蒂文·德索萨在《虎胆龙威》中最令人印象深刻的写作手法之一，便是结尾。短短四页，十几个支线剧情便被巧妙地串联起来，一一收束。从汉斯的死，到中富债券如圣诞雪花般飘落，再到霍莉放弃她的金劳力士（象征着所有的贪婪），以及豪华轿车司机阿盖尔在地下车库砸毁逃亡车辆，英雄与搭档（麦克莱恩和鲍威尔）的首次正面交锋，索恩伯格因多管闲事而被揍了一拳，罗宾逊局长的官僚作风被彻底无视，卡尔为哥哥之死孤注一掷的复仇，鲍威尔警官恢复射击能力，以及霍莉和麦克莱恩的重逢……所有这一切，以及更多精彩内容，都流畅地呈现在短短四页之中。德索萨将如此错综复杂的剧情处理得如此轻松优雅。


By weaving together the big action story fueled by the plan of a larger than life villain, with the smaller, personal story of a husband who must find the courage to admit he is wrong before he can reconcile with his estranged wife; Steven deSouza has turned "Die Hard" into a classic action film, the model of what a genre script should strive for, and the barometer with which to measure all future action films.

史蒂文·德索萨巧妙地将一个由一个超凡脱俗的反派策划的宏大动作故事，与一个丈夫必须鼓起勇气承认自己错了才能与疏远的妻子和解的较小、更私人的故事交织在一起，使《虎胆龙威》成为一部经典的动作电影，成为类型剧本应该努力追求的典范，以及衡量所有未来动作电影的风向标。


FADE OUT

淡出


The version of the script cited in theis article is the Second Revised Draft, Revision #17, dated January 27, 1988.

本文引用的剧本版本为第二版修订稿，修订号 17，日期为 1988 年 1 月 27 日。

AFTERWORDS

后记


I never set out to write screenwriting articles and books, I'm a working pro screenwriter with a couple of producers wondering where their script is... But back in 1991 I complained to the editor of a screenwriting newsletter that no one writing for them had ever sold a script that got made... and ended up being an unpaid writer for them. Now I had to figure out how to explain how screenplays worked and why they sometimes didn't work. Suddenly I found myself writing about writing for a bunch of publications including Writers Digest and Movie Maker and the Independent Film Channel Magazine. Oh, and Script Magazine. Some written advice I gave some fellow pro writers ended up becoming my book “The Secrets Of Action Screenwriting” and the Blue Book series followed. Once I began looking at how scripts worked (or did not work) I couldn't stop writing articles – and now have a website and a blog and about 7 books worth of screenwriting articles on my hard drive.

我从未想过要写剧本写作的文章和书籍。我是一名职业编剧，有几位制片人正在苦苦等待他们的剧本……但早在1991年，我曾向一家剧本写作通讯的编辑抱怨，他们刊登的剧本从来没有被拍成电影……结果，我成了他们的义务编剧。现在，我不得不琢磨如何解释剧本的运作原理以及它们为何有时会失败。突然间，我发现自己开始为包括《作家文摘》（Writers Digest）、《电影制作人》（Movie Maker）和《独立电影频道杂志》（Independent Film Channel Magazine）在内的多家刊物撰写关于剧本写作的文章。哦，还有《剧本杂志》（Script Magazine）。我给一些同行编剧的建议最终汇集成书——《动作剧本写作的秘密》（The Secrets Of Action Screenwriting），之后又推出了“蓝皮书”系列。一旦我开始研究剧本的运作原理（或失败原因），我就停不下来地写文章——现在，我拥有一个网站、一个博客，硬盘里还存着相当于七本书的剧本写作文章。


If you liked the information in THE SECRETS OF ACTION SCREENWRITING and want more - for *free* - check out my Script Tip of the day at http://www.ScriptSecrets.Net - there are 380 of them in rotation, and when I get to 500 I'm putting it on automatic and going to the beach.

如果你喜欢《动作剧本写作的秘密》中的信息，并且想要了解更多——而且是*免费的*——请访问我的每日剧本技巧网站 http://www.ScriptSecrets.Net——目前有 380 条技巧轮播更新，等我更新到 500 条的时候，我就把它设为自动更新，然后去海滩度假。


I also have a blog where I chronicle my adventures in Hollywood and talk about my favorite films and generally complain a lot. http://sex-in-a-sub.blogspot.com Don't let the title fool you, there is no sex involved, it's a terrible note I got from HBO on my rash Dive! movie. You can read about it on the blog.

我还有一个博客，专门记录我在好莱坞的奇遇，聊聊我最喜欢的电影，以及各种抱怨。http://sex-in-a-sub.blogspot.com 别被标题误导了，里面没有任何性描写，这只是HBO对我那部仓促拍出来的电影《Dive!》的糟糕评价。你可以在博客上看到相关内容。


You can also follow me on Twitter at http://www.twitter.com/wcmartell every once in a while I might say something funny, and I often post links to articles from my vault.

您也可以在 Twitter 上关注我：http://www.twitter.com/wcmartell，我偶尔会说些有趣的话，而且我经常发布我收藏的文章链接。


And if you could do could do me a favor and write a review of this Action Book at Amazon , that would be great. I'm not asking you to lie and write a good review if you didn't like it – be honest! Any problems you had with the book will be used to improve the next version (which you will probably plug right into your skull). But if you *did* like the book, if you would be so kind as to tweet your friends, FB status them, mention it on message boards, Google Plus your circles, and call everyone in your cell phone contact list at 4am while drunk and tell them you liked it; that would be great! The Secrtets Of Action Screenwriting Book has always been a word of mouth thing – no advertizing, people who like them tell their screenwriting friends. Which is how all of the pro writers got hold of it - friends told them if was good. So if you liked it, please don't keep it a secret!

如果你能帮我个忙，在亚马逊上写一篇关于这本动作剧本写作书的评论，那就太好了。我不是要你撒谎写个好评——如果你不喜欢这本书，请务必诚实！你对这本书的任何问题都会被用来改进下一版（你大概会把下一版牢牢记在脑子里）。但如果你*确实*喜欢这本书，如果你能好心地在推特上告诉你的朋友，在脸书上更新状态，在论坛上提及，在谷歌+上分享给你的圈子，甚至在凌晨四点喝醉的时候给手机通讯录里的每个人打电话，告诉他们你喜欢这本书，那就太棒了！《动作剧本写作秘诀》这本书一直以来都是靠口碑传播的——没有广告，喜欢它的人会告诉他们的编剧朋友。所有专业编剧都是这样得到这本书的——朋友们告诉他们这本书很好。所以，如果你喜欢这本书，请不要藏着掖着！

ABOUT THE AUTHOR

关于作者


William C. Martell just handed in the first draft for the studio remake of a classic 1980s horror film, and has written 19 films that were carelessly slapped onto celluloid: 3 for HBO, 2 for Showtime, 2 for USA Net, and a whole bunch of CineMax Originals (which is what happens when an HBO movie goes really, really wrong). He's been on some film festival juries, including Raindance in London (twice - once with Mike Figgis and Saffron Burrows, once with Lennie James and Edgar Wright – and was called back to "jury duty" in October of 2009). Roger Ebert discussed his work with Gene Siskel on his 1997 "If We Picked The Winners" Oscar show. He's quoted a few times in Bordwell's great book "The Way Hollywood tells It". He has written a column for Script Magazine since 1991, and is now “Editor At Large” (which he suspects may be a dig at his weight) and has a column in every issue. His USA Net flick HARD EVIDENCE was released on video the same day as the Julia Roberts' film Something To Talk About and out-rented it in the USA. In 2007 he had two films released on DVD on the same day (one from Lions Gate, one from Sony) and both made the top 10 rentals.

威廉·C·马特尔刚刚交出了一部经典80年代恐怖片的翻拍剧本初稿，这部翻拍片由电影公司制作。他曾创作过19部电影剧本，但都被草率地搬上了银幕：3部为HBO，2部为Showtime，2部为USA Network，还有一大堆CineMax原创电影（这通常是HBO电影彻底失败后的产物）。他曾担任过一些电影节的评委，包括伦敦的雨舞电影节（两次——一次是和迈克·菲吉斯和萨弗蓉·布罗斯，一次是和伦尼·詹姆斯和埃德加·赖特——并在2009年10月再次被召回担任评委）。罗杰·艾伯特曾在1997年与吉恩·西斯克尔一起主持的奥斯卡颁奖典礼节目“如果我们选出赢家”中讨论过他的作品。博德威尔的杰作《好莱坞的叙事方式》中也多次引用过他的话。他自1991年起便为《剧本杂志》（Script Magazine）撰写专栏，如今已是该杂志的“特约编辑”（他怀疑这个头衔可能是在暗讽他的体重），每期都有专栏文章。他执导的USA Net电影《铁证如山》（HARD EVIDENCE）与茱莉亚·罗伯茨主演的《情到深处》（Something To Talk About）同日发行录像带，并在美国取得了更高的租赁成绩。2007年，他有两部电影（一部由狮门影业发行，一部由索尼发行）在同一天发行DVD，两部电影都跻身租赁榜前十。


His book “The Secrets Of Action Screenwriting” is an industry standard. Last year a copy of his book THE SECRETS OF ACTION SCREENWRITING sold on e-bay for $999.00 – he didn't make a cent off the deal.

他的著作《动作剧本创作的秘密》是业内经典之作。去年，他的这本书在eBay上以999美元的价格售出——但他一分钱也没赚到。


Mr. Martell has been interviewed in Variety (February 24, 1997), featured in The Hollywood Reporter's first Writers Special Issue (February 1994), was the cover interview in The Hollywood Scriptwriter (October 1996), and was interviewed in the first issue of ScreenTalk Magazine (Denmark). Entertainment Today (March 23, 2001) named his website ScriptSecrets.Net the Best On The Web for screenwriters... and his blog was selected as one of the best by Bachelor's Degree Org.

马特尔先生曾接受《综艺》（1997年2月24日）的采访，登上《好莱坞报道》首期编剧特刊（1994年2月），成为《好莱坞编剧》（1996年10月）的封面人物，并在丹麦《ScreenTalk》杂志创刊号上接受采访。《今日娱乐》（2001年3月23日）将他的网站ScriptSecrets.Net评为网络上最佳的编剧网站……他的博客也被Bachelor's Degree Org评选为最佳博客之一。


Past students of Martell's big two day class have sold scripts to Miramax, George Clooney's Section Eight Productions, Joel Silver Films, and the amazing Steve Robinson took what he learned in the class and wrote the winner of the Nokia International Short Film Competition, "Have I Passed?".

马特尔为期两天的大型课程的往届学生曾将剧本卖给米拉麦克斯影业、乔治·克鲁尼的第八区制片公司、乔尔·西尔弗电影公司，而才华横溢的史蒂夫·罗宾逊则运用他在课堂上学到的知识，创作了诺基亚国际短片大赛的获奖作品《我通过了吗？》。


Mr. Martell has taught screenwriting courses at Sherwood Oaks College in Los Angeles, for Project Greenlight in Los Angeles, at the Cripple Creek (Colorado) Film Festival, the Ft. Lauderdale (Florida) Film Festival, the Temecula (California) Film Festival, several times at the Santa Fe Screenwriters Conference along side Oscar winners William Kelley (WITNESS), David S. Ward (THE STING), and Oscar nominees Chris DeVore (THE ELEPHANT MAN) and Mark Medoff (CHILDREN OF A LESSER GOD), twice at the Las Vegas Screenwriting Conference along side Steven Katz (SHADOW OF THE VAMPIRE), Shane Black (LETHAL WEAPON), and Ross LaManna (RUSH HOUR), and three times taught classes at the Sacramento (California) Film Festival.

马特尔先生曾在洛杉矶舍伍德橡树学院、洛杉矶绿灯计划、科罗拉多州克里普尔克里克电影节、佛罗里达州劳德代尔堡电影节、加利福尼亚州特梅库拉电影节教授剧本写作课程，并多次在圣达菲编剧大会上与奥斯卡奖得主威廉·凯利（《证人》）、大卫·S·沃德（《骗中骗》）以及奥斯卡奖提名者克里斯·德沃（《象人》）和马克·梅多夫（《失宠于上帝的孩子》）共同授课，两次在拉斯维加斯编剧大会上与史蒂文·卡茨（《吸血鬼的阴影》）、沙恩·布莱克（《致命武器》）和罗斯·拉曼纳（《尖峰时刻》）共同授课，并三次在加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托电影节上授课。


Mr. Martell's book, THE SECRETS OF ACTION SCREENWRITING has been called: "The best book on the practical nuts-and-bolts mechanics of writing a screenplay I've ever read." - Ted Elliott, co-writer "The Mask Of Zorro", "Shrek", all of the "Pirates Of The Caribbean" movies.

马特尔先生的著作《动作剧本写作的秘密》被誉为：“我读过的关于剧本写作实用技巧的最佳书籍。”——泰德·埃利奥特，《佐罗的面具》、《怪物史莱克》以及所有《加勒比海盗》系列电影的联合编剧。

“威廉·C·马特尔对动作片类型了如指掌。向专家学习吧！”——马克·维海登，《时空特警》、《变相怪杰》以及电视剧《超人前传》和《陨落星辰》的编剧。


"This book is dangerous. I feel threatened by it." -Roger Avary, Oscar winning screenwriter, "Pulp Fiction".

“这本书很危险。我感到受到了威胁。”——罗杰·艾弗里，奥斯卡获奖编剧，《低俗小说》


"My only complaint with SECRETS OF ACTION SCREENWRITING is that it wasn't around when I was starting out. The damned thing would have saved me years of trial and error!" - Ken Wheat, screenwriter, "Pitch Black" and "The Fly 2".

“我对《动作片编剧秘诀》唯一的抱怨就是它没在我刚入行的时候出现。要是早点有这本书，我就能省去好几年的摸索和试错！”——肯·惠特，《星际传奇》和《变蝇人2》的编剧。

Mr. Martell was born in the same hospital, in the same month, as Tom Hanks. Many believe they were switched at birth, and Bill should be the movie star. He lives in Studio City, California, and can be found most afternoons at some coffee shop writing some darned new script on his laptop.

马特尔先生和汤姆·汉克斯在同一家医院、同一个月出生。许多人认为他们出生时被抱错了，比尔才应该是电影明星。他住在加利福尼亚州的斯图迪奥城，大多数下午都能在咖啡馆里看到他，用笔记本电脑写着一些新剧本。

THE SECRETS OF ACTION SCREENWRITING – revised for 2011 . The screenwriting book recommended by Oscar winners and screenwriters of mega-hit movies. “The Secrets Of Action Screenwriting is the best book on the practical nuts-and-bolts mechanics of writing a screenplay I've ever read,” Ted Elliott, co-writer of the “Pirates Of The Caribbean” movies, “Shrek”, “Mask Of Zorro”, and many others.

动作片剧本创作秘诀——2011年修订版。本书由奥斯卡奖得主和多部热门电影的编剧推荐。“《动作片剧本创作秘诀》是我读过的关于剧本创作实用技巧的最佳书籍。”——泰德·埃利奥特（Ted Elliott），《加勒比海盗》系列、《怪物史莱克》、《佐罗的面具》等多部影片的联合编剧。
